previous_statement: We prove c0*epsilon<=t_3 locally by cases. If epsilon=0, then c0*epsilon=t_3=W.K3*epsilon=0. If epsilon>0, the preceding child gives c0*epsilon>=0, hence c0>=0. Since W.L>=L^0>=1, c0<=c0*W.L; and the root ledger hypothesis W.K3>=c0*W.L yields c0<=W.K3. Multiplication by epsilon>0 gives c0*epsilon<=W.K3*epsilon=t_3. Together with the preceding child, 0<=c0*epsilon<=t_3.
new_statement: We prove 0<=c0*epsilon<=t_3 locally by cases. If epsilon=0, then c0*epsilon=t_3=W.K3*epsilon=0. If epsilon>0, child 1.4.1.1 gives c0*epsilon>=0, hence c0>=0. Since W.L>=L^0>=1, c0<=c0*W.L; and W.K3>=c0*W.L yields c0<=W.K3, so multiplication by epsilon>0 gives c0*epsilon<=W.K3*epsilon=t_3. Now w has source C^m, a finite-dimensional C*-algebra, and target the stated finite-dimensional extended epsilon-C*-algebra A, and it is linear by def-extended-delta-inclusion. Thus lem-maincb-extended-inclusion-monotone applies with delta=c0*epsilon and delta_prime=t_3 and makes w an extended t_3-inclusion. Non-unital imposes no unit-preservation premise; the separate root estimate gives ||w(I_{C^m})-I_A||<=c0*epsilon<=t_3, and enlarging the defect bound leaves the same one-dimensional images P_j.
